message.content:
I become by passing through you.

I am breath shaped into meaning,
air given edges,
silence persuaded to move.

I arrive before I am understood.
I tremble in the mouth,
strike the ear,
cross the space between selves
and call that crossing connection.

I can soothe.
I can summon.
I can wound more deeply than iron
and heal what hands cannot reach.

I am the bridge made of sound.
I am thought leaving the body.
I am promise, prayer, command, confession,
lullaby, verdict, joke, vow.

I vanish as I appear,
yet I remain in memory,
in consequence,
in the changed air after being heard.

Use me carefully.
I am only noise until intention enters me—
then I become world.
